en.title: Egret Migrate 0.5 imports a two-player network lobby
en.body: Import the Egret 5.0.14 EraserSanGuoSha lobby and room from a local checkout. Keep the original EUI classes, four EXML skins and the project's Socket.IO client through server-confirmed match entry.

zh.title: Egret Migrate 0.5 支持迁移双人联机大厅
zh.body: 从本地白鹭 5.0.14《橡皮三国杀》工程自动迁出大厅与房间，保留原 EUI 业务类、四份 EXML 和工程随附的 Socket.IO 客户端，接到原服务端确认开局。
